about_the_game:
The colorful world of Cosminomy offers simple yet engaging turn-based strategy mechanics. Succeed as a space colonist by building sufficient structures on gridless planetary surfaces. Manage your resources wisely and expand your colony to new worlds.

Become a spacelord by developing superior tactics, or simply enjoy the relaxing gameplay and cozy aesthetics.

ABOUT GAMEPLAY

  • No grids or tiles, only free building.

  • Populate little planets with various facilities. Utilize their unique mechanics by selecting optimal locations.

  • Form efficient relations between neighbouring buildings to turn local valuables into great profits.

  • No time pressure. Advance step by step.

  • Each building placement represents a new turn, when all your incomes are calculated. Invest wisely in the next facility to steadily grow your infrastructure.

  • No card mechanics, you decide what to build next.

  • Gather scientific data from colonized planets and spend it on researching new facilities.

  • No unit management and battles, but you can pop clouds with the cursor.

  • Advance from planet to planet, estabilishing a multigalactic economy.

  • Each biome has different challenges and valuables for your colony. Cosminomy is more about adaptation than terraforming.

  • Will you respect the natives or sacrifice their homes for the greater profit?

Cosminomy is expected to launch in 2025. Add to wishlist and stay tuned for updates!
